skills.name: 谮构
skills.text: 当你攻击范围内一名角色使用【闪】时，你可以弃置一张非基本牌或失去1点体力，令此【闪】无效，然后你获得之。
notes: Trigger zengou-nullify: slashFullyDodged, ownerRelation observer, optional; trigger condition compare(ownerEventTargetDistance <= currentAttackRange) pre-filters to characters within the owner's attack range; the operation re-checks with IsWithinAttackRange.

Bespoke op zengouNullifyDodge (7253): requires a frozen card action, a single-target attack (multi-target attacks do not fire, recorded boundary), and the latest card.response-finished discard-pile entity whose advanced kind is Dodge; then a private prompt offers one non-basic card (hand or equipment, CardCatalog category != 基本牌) per card plus 失去1点体力.

Payment nullifies the Dodge by setting CurrentCardEnhancement.Uncancelable on the attack CardUseFrame (same mechanism as the red-slash policy), so the subsequent ContinueSlashAfterDodgePrograms damage check reads it; the Dodge entity then moves DiscardPile -> Hand with reason skill-program.ol:zengou.zengou-gain.

Converted or virtual Dodges have no Dodge-kind entity; they are nullified without a gain (recorded boundary). If paying HP empties it, the nullify and gain complete before BeginProgramSkillDying suspends into the dying flow.

skills.name: 长姬
skills.text: 一名角色的结束阶段，若你本回合：造成过伤害，你可以令其摸两张牌；受到过伤害，你可以令其弃置两张牌。
notes: Triggers changji-ending-own (turnEnding, turnOwnerScope own) and changji-ending-others (turnEnding, turnOwnerScope otherLiving): mandatory trigger, the choice lives inside the operation.

Bespoke op changjiEndingDamageChoice (7252): damage history is rebuilt from committed DamageAppliedEvent records since the TurnStartedEvent boundary of the current turn; 造成过伤害 = SourceSeat == owner && !SourceLess && Amount > 0, 受到过伤害 = TargetSeat == owner && Amount > 0.
A private-to-public choice prompt offers 令其摸两张牌 (dealt) and 令其弃置两张牌 (taken) plus 不发动; 其 is the ending character (WindowContext.TargetSeat of the turnEnding window).

The draw branch draws two for the ending character; the discard branch follows the Bijing punish two-stage pattern (ChangjiDiscardState on the program frame): the ending character discards min(2, hand count) of their own hand cards, one prompt each.

observations: Official hero/info API (gid=498, fetched 2026-10-08) confirms 清河公主 as wei 3HP 史诗 with labels 进攻/控制/卖血 and characteristic 可以无效化敌人的闪，与能为你制造回合外输出的队友配合更好。 — the characteristic matches the sgsol 谮构 wording, not the sgs-main wording.

Cross-site divergence (coordinator alert): wiki.biligame.com/sgs/清河公主 (oldid=70271, edited 2025-05-20) carries the 十周年-classic version — title 大魏长公主, package 荟萃-皇家贵胄, release 2024-10-24, skills 长姬(锁定技, multi-target priority draw) + 谮构(gift-mark-punish). It matches the official API on hp 3 / 魏 but disagrees on skills, title, package and timeline. It is NOT the OL current normal version and was not used.

wiki.biligame.com/sgsol/清河公主 (oldid=31193) is the OL-specific wiki: title 魏长公主, package 璀璨星河-天极, release 2022-05-20, 谮构(闪无效获得) + 长姬(结束阶段摸/弃). Its skill texts match the official hero page body verbatim modulo the final clause (official page: 然后你获得此【闪】。; sgsol: 然后你获得之。), and both match the API characteristic. sgsol is taken as the authoritative verbatim source; the official page body is only a cross-check (its og:description even claims 0体力, showing the static template is unreliable).
The first implementation (commit a7374e03) was built on the sgs-main 十周年 texts before the cross-check; it was reworked onto the OL wording in commit 0a614ffc in the same batch.

New bespoke ops 7252-7253 (changjiEndingDamageChoice, zengouNullifyDodge); no new trigger windows, condition kinds, value kinds, PlayerMarkerKind or schema nodes. The only shared change beyond the new ops is the schema whitelist extension allowing CurrentAttackRange comparisons on slashFullyDodged (additive; the window's frozen facts already compute CurrentAttackRange unconditionally).
BWIKI fetches on 2026-10-08 both returned HTTP 200 on the first attempt (no EdgeOne 567 retry needed); raw HTML and extracted text kept under the batch temp workdir during development.
versionBoundary: 谮构 triggers at slashFullyDodged, i.e. after the Dodge has fully resolved, and retroactively nullifies it before the slash damage check runs; the official wording 当…使用【闪】时 would fire at the use instant. The observable ordering difference only matters for skills that trigger between the dodge use and its completion.

谮构 only fires against single-target attacks. On a multi-target attack the Uncancelable flag cannot be scoped to one target (HasCurrentCardEnhancement reads the whole CardUseFrame), so firing would bleed onto other targets' dodges; the operation declines instead (recorded gap).
谮构 gains the Dodge entity only when the settled response entity's advanced kind is Dodge (converted/virtual Dodges gain nothing).

长姬 damage history counts every committed DamageAppliedEvent of the current turn with Amount > 0 (source side excluding SourceLess); chain/transfer attribution follows the engine's DamageAppliedEvent fields.
长姬 discard branch discards hand cards only (standard 弃置两张牌 reading); if the ending character has fewer than two hand cards they discard what they have; zero hand cards voids the branch.

Both skills' prompts are realised per the engine's DecisionKind.ProgramTrigger machinery; the AI heuristics are deterministic (长姬: draw for self, discard for others; 谮构: prefer the discard cost over losing HP; the optional activation itself is priced by the generic estimate, which values 谮构 at zero, so the AI effectively declines it).
